BB Ball.name: BB Ball
BB Ball.summary: BB Ball is a Sports game, developed and published by Micott & Basara, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Blue Angelo - Angels from the Shrine.name: Blue Angelo: Angels from the Shrine
Blue Angelo - Angels from the Shrine.summary:
A role-playing game for the GamePark 32. This was the last game released on the GamePark 32.
The gba port was cancelled after cancellation of the gamepark 32 in Europe.
